test_starspace_basic_training: test the starspace model training with batch size 1 on integration_tests task
test_starspace_advanced_options: test the starspace model training with input dropout, tfidf, and unshared embeddings
test_starspace_fixed_candidates: test the starspace model evaluation using a fixed candidates file built by BuildCandidates
run_train_model_starspace: run the testing_utils train_model function to train a starspace model on integration_tests
run_build_candidates: run BuildCandidates.main to generate a fixed candidates file for the integration_tests task
